mechanisms.projectile: The weapon normal projectile (see attack:projectile_source() for where it lives).
mechanisms.rounds_magazine: One of the two WeaponRounds magazines (primary +64, alternate +68), switched with the Magazine weapon function. Both are built into every weapon; their projectiles are set by its default ammunition customization.
mechanisms.programmable_ammo: ProjectileWeapon +576: fired instead of the normal projectile while the ProgrammableAmmo weapon function is on (AC-8, GR-8, RL-77 natively).

notConflated.multiple_projectiles: Pellets per shot are projectile.pellet_count on the projectile row.
notConflated.submunitions: Shrapnel and bomblets hang off the projectile impact explosion (explosion.shrapnel_*).
notConflated.default_ammunition: weapon:ammunition() is the customization that owns the normal projectile of six weapons.
notConflated.output_family: Beam, arc, spray and melee outputs are their own components (OutputCompositionCapabilities).

binding.rule: bound in the same transaction as function_ammo.projectile

assets: A donor output package loads automatically before function_ammo.projectile is written (0.27 loader).
